fusions.name: Rammed Shot
fusions.desc: Fires a cloth-wadded ball that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets. It holds 5 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Flash Cartridge
fusions.desc: Bursts a rag-stoppered charge in a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage to everything caught in it and knocking it back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Swabbed Barrel
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown of one of your other abilities, chosen at random.

fusions.name: Bandolier
fusions.desc: Conjures a cartridge bandolier: your critical chance rises by 4%, your critical hits deal 12% more damage, your attack speed rises by 5%, and each kill returns 2 health.
